Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

package Problems_On_Number;

import java.util.Scanner;

public class GCD {
    static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        if (b == 0) {
            return a;
        }
        return gcd(b, a % b);
    }

    public static void main(String args[]) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.println("enter the first number:");
        int a = sc.nextInt();
        System.out.println("enter the second number:");
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int ans = gcd(a, b);
        System.out.print("The GCD of the two numbers is " + ans);
        sc.close();
    }

}
